scoring_justification: T1 recompute from the agent's aggregated CSVs and JSON is feasible: melting confirmation (S_centre, energy) can be read and checked; density profiles can be compared; comparison metrics can be cross-validated against the underlying CSVs. No external hidden labels are required.

outputs.description: Table of centre static structure factor and internal energy per atom in the GB region versus temperature, used to confirm the interface melting transition.
Atom density profile along Y from the heating simulation at 300 K.
Atom density profile along Y from the quenching simulation at 300 K.
Key metrics comparing the central GB density peaks between heating and quenching at 300 K.

output_contract.notes: The checker will validate that the structure factor drops near zero and the internal energy jumps near 1088 K from the melting_confirmation.csv, and that the quenching peak density is lower than the heating peak at 300 K. The comparison_metrics.json values must be consistent with the corresponding density CSVs.

steps.description: Confirm interface melting: S_centre < 0.05 at 1100 K and energy jump between 1000 K and 1100 K.
Ensure the heating density profile has a central peak above a minimal threshold, confirming a crystalline GB structure.
Verify that the quenching density profile has a central peak and that its magnitude is strictly lower than the heating central peak.
Cross-check the reported peak densities and difference against the actual CSVs; ensure internal consistency and positive difference.
